alerts.title: Viral load monitoring overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines state VL should be measured every 6-12 months for adults on stable ART. The patient's most recent viral load was on 2025-09-15, 129 days before this visit, which is within the acceptable interval. However, no viral load has been ordered at this encounter, and the next VL should be planned to ensure no gap exceeds 12 months. The clinician's plan does not include any lab orders.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm next VL is scheduled by September 2026 at the latest, or order one now if clinically indicated.

alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring frequency gap
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine monitoring for patients on TDF. The latest creatinine (76 umol/L on 2025-12-15) is normal and stable. However, only one creatinine result is on record. No creatinine monitoring is included in today's plan. While the current value is reassuring, ongoing periodic renal monitoring is required for TDF-containing regimens to detect late nephrotoxicity.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue routine serum creatinine monitoring per TDF guidelines at the next scheduled interval.
